Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, measurement backlog and failed-work containment remain open, and operations/security evidence is incomplete. Continue only existing measurement, repair-or-close, period-aligned finance reconciliation, security evidence, private launch gates, and parked-site readiness.

Complete or justifiably close the retained saveusfarms.com failure by 2026-09-30T07:30Z. Require dated ownership, root-cause or closure rationale, isolated deterministic validation, build checks, rollback point, release/security boundary, attribution and measurement limits, and deduplication evidence. Do not retry unchanged work or create a duplicate request. Re-read capacity only after the artifact exists.

Measure deployed work using available telemetry only. Preserve unavailable revenue, conversion, attribution, and causal-lift fields as unknown. Do not add tracking, create follow-up work, or requeue failures. Capacity must not be released until each applicable improvement has an explicit keep, rollback, or close disposition.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Keep public exposure and security-sensitive releases blocked while fleet-doctor, operations, and material control evidence remain unavailable. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, or conduct outreach.

Continue the existing complicated.work readiness packet. Keep the site parked, private, preview-only, and launch-blocked. Attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security unknowns, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit-blocker evidence by 2026-09-30T17:00Z. Do not build, publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue work.

Preserve the 2026-09-21 Amazon result as aggregate and unattributed: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. Keep matching-period costs, budgets, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, infrastructure spend, and cost-to-learn unknown. Do not extrapolate or authorize spend.

Retain the three control-plane specifications as deferred designs only. They are technically feasible as bounded, reversible, record-composition changes, but implementation is not safely admissible while delivery is full, failed-work containment is open, measurement locks remain active, and operations/security evidence is incomplete. Reconsider only after capacity and evidence gates reopen.
